_provenance: Float reference parameters for the rotation-averaged hemibrain v1.2.1 ring (data/cx_averaged.npz, derive_cx.average): the 134 measured EPG/PEN/D7 neurons, evenly spaced per class, wired with the measured connection profiles by angle (smoothed 0.75 wedge, pairs under 0.5 synapse pruned). The exact measured wiring (spec/params_hemibrain.json, DRAFT) pins the bump in a few resting spots and cannot turn smoothly; the user chose this averaged ring (step 1 of 'averaged, then blend').

Tuned 2026-09-19 in a Claude Code session (scratch tooling, not in the repo): searches scored on T1-T8 from every start wedge (5 seeds), then on the worst normalized margin at nominal. Smoothing 0.5, 0.75 and 1.0 wedge were each tuned; 0.75 gave the widest hold (T2) and rate (T6) margins. Values are stored at full precision: rounding to 4 significant figures made seed 0 drift 1.02 wedges from one start (T2 limit 1.0).
Verified with the real suite: T1-T8 pass on seeds 0-15 (0-4 are the spec seeds, 5-15 held out).

Robustness: this ring does NOT meet the +/-10% one-at-a-time gate. Scans put several gains' passing windows under +/-5% (w_ee, w_ed fail at +/-5%); failures are rare events, typically one of 80 seed x start cases drifting a full wedge. Neither wider smoothing nor margin maximization widened the windows. The user decided to ship it at nominal as the trading fly and keep the robust 56-neuron fly (spec/params.json) as legacy: see robustness_gate.
Units: 1 tick = dt ms; currents in the model's units, where the threshold current is v_thresh/tau.

_protocol_notes.source: None of these values are given in the brief; tuned with the model and recorded here.
_protocol_notes.landmark_current: chosen by the search (T4 needs enough to pull the bump 180 deg; T6 caps the rates)
_protocol_notes.t3_drive_levels: push-pull levels = [0.283, 0.667, 1.592] x v_thresh/tau, chosen by the search; CCW and faster with drive from every start wedge (T3)
_protocol_notes.t8_drive: 0.5 x v_thresh/tau on both PEN_L and PEN_R
_protocol_notes.t7_noise_amp: 0.1 x v_thresh / sqrt(tau/2): stationary membrane-noise std = 10% of threshold

_robustness_gate_note: Waived for this spec by user decision (2026-09-19): the averaged hemibrain ring passes T1-T8 at its tuned values but not +/-10% one-at-a-time; the robustness record is still measured and must be current. spec/params.json keeps the +/-10% gate.

measured_on.suite: T1-T8; T2 (with set-at <= 1 wedge) and T3 from every start wedge

robustness.gate: waived for this spec (user decision, see _robustness_gate_note); corners are recorded but not gated. A null margin = fails already at the smallest delta (for margin_with_corners, only when corners_run is true).
robustness.method: w_ee, w_ed, w_de, w_ep, w_pe, w_dd, w_dp, w_pp scaled by 1+/-delta one at a time (16 configs), corners not run (--no-corners; margin_with_corners null); T1-T8; T2 (with set-at <= 1 wedge) and T3 from every start wedge, on every seed; margin = largest delta on the grid [0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3] at which every config passes
